# Cncf Curve Reviewer

Review Curve using its official documentation and repository in the Runtime / Cloud Native Storage category. Curve is a distributed storage system designed and developed independently by NetEase,  featured with high performance, high availability, high reliability and well expansibility,  and it can serve as the basis for storage systems designed for different scenario.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
